name: invalidate_by_tags
description:
Marks a cache tag as stale, causing cache entries associated with that tag to be revalidated in the background on the next request.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/edge-cache/invalidate-by-tags --method POST. Fill placeholders from inputs.
